text: Lactose itself comes from whey permeate, crystallised upstream. Grade details are from supplier literature (Meggle), which is low authority.

sources.text: The table, the facts and the words on how it is made, from these.

steps.note: The lactose crystals are milled finely, for the spray-dried grade.
The milled lactose is mixed into water.
The mixture is spray-dried into round grains, crystals of lactose held in lactose that has not crystallised.

sources.text: Wikipedia for lactose from whey permeate evaporated to 60-65 % solids and crystallised on cooling; a supplier's page for the spray-dried grade. The agglomerated and anhydrous grades are not drawn, for lack of an openable source.
